name: Add-Row Button (guarded append, icon + text)
description: The 'Add New Row' button beneath a line-items grid. Combines four patterns: a guard that aborts the append when header prerequisites are missing, an index-less mergedatasetarray append, a computed serial number, and an icon+label compound button body. Wrapped in a hide so it disappears in view mode.
sourceRefs: examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md 3.10 (line-items grid, guarded on PUR_AC_DOCNO + PUR_SUBLEDGER_DOCNO)

guardFields.description: Header fields that must be non-empty before a row may be added.

patternNotes.guardBeforeAppend: validatedataset with halton:"match" ABORTS the remaining actions in the array when the condition matches, so the append never runs. satisfy:"any" fires if ANY listed field is blank; use "all" to require every one to be blank.
patternNotes.isEmptyIdiom: "[X(ifnull)raw.]": "" reads as 'coalesce X to empty string, compare to empty string'. Note raw. with nothing after it is a legal empty-string literal.
patternNotes.appendSemantics: mergedatasetarray with NO index appends a new row. With an index it updates that row; with an index and data:null it deletes that row.
patternNotes.computedSerial: [DS(listcount)(+)raw.1(numformat)raw.0] = current row count + 1, zero decimal places.
patternNotes.compoundButtonBody: btn.chld is an ARRAY holding a flex div that wraps an icon and a lbl — this is how icon+text buttons are built (there is no startIcon prop).
